capabilities: highlight open notes in the graph view with a custom color
enlarge open notes to a fixed size independent of link count
dim non-open nodes to a set opacity
optionally tint linked notes and edges connected to open or pinned notes
adjust color, size, and opacity from an in-graph control panel
extras: The README states the plugin's code was written with Claude (Anthropic) and curated by the author; it is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or later; works on desktop and mobile.
problem: In Obsidian's graph view it is hard to tell which nodes correspond to notes you currently have open.

relations.evidence: reads the layout of a workspace saved by Obsidian's Workspaces core plugin

summary: Graph view add-on that highlights currently open notes with a custom color and fixed size while dimming all other nodes.
